design_notes: Echo Grid is the official in-world name of the collectible card minigame.
Core game uses a 3x3 grid and five cards per player.
Each card has north, east, south, and west ranks.
Normal capture occurs when the placed card's touching rank is greater than the opposing card's touching rank.
Same triggers when two or more touching rank pairs are equal and captures eligible opposing cards.
Plus triggers when two or more touching rank sums are equal and captures eligible opposing cards.
Combo allows cards captured by Same or Plus to immediately apply normal capture checks outward.
This subsystem is not used in the opening vertical slice.
Card identities, art, factions, rewards, NPC opponents, and world placement remain non-canon until separately approved.
